Description of changes

The tea tool comes with shell completions for bash, zsh, fish and ps: https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/src/branch/main/contrib. This change installs the completions for bash and zsh. Currently, there is no simple way to get the fish completion script since it is generated at runtime and directly written on disk. Maybe someone who knows better can add the fish completion later.

items.content_html:
Motivation for this change

Make the behavior of command-not-found more consistent between NIX_AUTO_RUN on and off.

Which means, when NIX_AUTO_RUN set on, execute the command directly, and when NIX_AUTO_RUN set off, print the command to execute, not just print the command to enter a shell which contains the expected command in PATH.
